name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (UI/money animation domain). Descriptor accurately reflects behavior: animated decrement of party gold with a rolling-digit visual. No Ghidra address residue. Mirror of fd2_animate_money_increment @ 0x2D3FF, consistent naming.
purpose: Animated decrement of party gold (spend) with a rolling-digit slot-machine visual that counts each mismatching decimal digit DOWN.
logic_summary: sprintf the 8 current decimal digits of data_fd2_shared_party_total_gold (subtract 0x30 to get raw digit values), subtract delta from the gold total immediately, sprintf the 8 target digits. Outer do/while diffs cur vs new digits each pass: matching positions get anim_state=0; mismatching positions get anim_state=9, clear all_match, and are pre-decremented in the diff loop with a 0xFF->9 borrow. When not all-match, run an inner 9-frame roll: for each of 8 digit positions with anim_state!=0, blit descending sprite index (anim_state + cur_digit*9 - 1) at slot 0xA7A90 + pos*6 and decrement anim_state; fd2_delay_ms(10) per frame. Borrows to higher positions resolve on the next outer re-diff. Loops until current digits equal target digits.

params.name: delta
params.semantics: Amount of gold to subtract from the party total. Callers pass the transaction cost (shop purchase price; church revive payment).
params.reason: Name accurately describes the subtracted amount; no address residue; matches the increment sibling's parameter naming.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effects are the gold-total mutation and the on-screen rolling-digit animation.
